data.current_description:
How a fiscal year's figures changed across filings — as reported, then restated.

A company re-reports each fiscal year as a comparative in every later filing.
When a figure changes, that is a restatement, and this is the audit trail:
every reported value for the period, with the filing date, form, accession
and EDGAR link behind it.

This is what `as_of` acts on. `get_financials` returns the latest reported
figure; `as_of` rewinds to the value known on a date. Here you can see the
whole series at once — which years moved, by how much, and when.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve historical revisions for a fiscal period
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve the complete audit trail of reported and restated values for a company's fiscal year across all filings. Accepts company identifier (ticker or CIK), fiscal year, and optional account/metric filter. Returns RevisionEntry objects showing each reported value with its filing date, form type, accession number, and EDGAR link. Enables tracking restatements and understanding which values were known on specific dates. Complements get_financials (latest values) and as_of parameter (point-in-time snapshots).

data.current_description:
Report the calling key's current monthly quota state.

Free to call (does not consume quota) so clients can monitor consumption and
avoid hitting a hard 429. Month-aware: right after a billing-month rollover,
usage reads 0 even before the counter is physically reset on the next
metered request.

Through RapidAPI every subscriber shares one gateway key, so its numbers
say nothing about the caller: report the caller's RapidAPI plan instead
(from X-RapidAPI-Subscription, trusted only after the proxy-secret check),
with counts left null because RapidAPI meters and enforces them.
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve the authenticated caller's current monthly API quota usage and limits. This operation is free and does not consume quota, allowing clients to monitor consumption and avoid rate-limit errors (429). Returns quota state that is month-aware and resets after billing-month rollovers. For RapidAPI subscribers, returns the caller's RapidAPI plan information instead of raw counts, as RapidAPI handles metering and enforcement centrally.
